_doc: Final colour grade in the tonemap pass (src/render.cpp kToneFS), applied after the filmic curve in display-linear space. saturation: 1 = none removed (was 0.93 hard-coded; 0.91 = -9 % chroma). vignette: corner darkening factor (was 0.16). splitTone: 0 off .. 1 full; shadowTint / highlightTint multiply the colour below / above about twice the pivot luminance (cool shadows, warm highlights). Read once at start.
